terms.comment: Rest from work and from cares (Lewis & Short); the noun of quiēscere.

terms.gloss: leisure, time free of business; peace and quiet

phrases.latin: nam quī locus quiētis et tranquillitātis plēnissimus fore vidēbātur, in eō maximae mōlēs molestiārum et turbulentissimae tempestātēs exstitērunt
phrases.english: for the very time of life that looked like being fullest of peace and quiet brought the greatest mass of troubles and the wildest storms

phrases.latin: Somne, quiēs rērum, placidissime, Somne, deōrum, pāx animī, quem cūra fugit
phrases.english: Sleep, rest of all things, gentlest of the gods, Sleep, peace of the mind, from whom care flees

sources: Lewis & Short: quies · Lewis & Short: otium · Lewis & Short: tranquillitas
Quotations from the Latinitas loci collections (loci-ovidius), checked against the editions named there.
